items.title: Musk says SpaceX’s AI rivals are in trouble, sending their stocks lower
items.content: SpaceX just landed a $40 billion debt deal, but Musk says lenders won’t be so hospitable to less-diversified competitors.

items.title: A dot-com survivor warns retail investors against buying the tech dip: ‘You’re taking a knife to a gunfight.’
items.content: Technology-portfolio mangers are treading carefully with tech these days, retail investors should be just as cautious, says industry veteran Ted Mortonson.

items.title: Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom could buy Meta shares as part of $35 billion stock offering
items.content: Meta is looking to raise a total of $95 billion through stock-related deals that stretch into early next year.

items.title: My husband wants to sell our $1.5 million home and invest the proceeds. But this is where we raised our kids — and I can’t bear to leave.
items.content: “He wants to buy something for $600,000 now that we are empty-nesters.”

items.title: The stock market’s biggest test in weeks is here
items.content: Here’s what’s I’m watching this morning: A week chockablock with enough catalysts that we might finally get some answers about the direction of the market by the end of it.

items.title: Verizon’s stock rises as subscriber surge impresses Wall Street
items.content: Verizon’s performance on a key measure of subscriber growth was more than double what analysts had expected

items.title: We stopped helping our neighbors with free home repairs and our friendship cooled. Who’s to blame?
items.content: “Last summer, they complained about needing to replace their roof. A few months later, they bought a new SUV.”

items.title: These four shocks could hand investors an unexpected buying window, strategists say
items.content: Yardeni Research said a surprise interest-rate decision by the Federal Reserve or increasing constraints in the artificial-intelligence trade could provide valuable entry points for investors.

items.title: The Kospi index is the leading indicator for the global AI trade — and Goldman just slashed its forecast by 25%
items.content: A reduction in the growth multiple that investors are prepared to pay for AI stocks and a rise in volatility has forced Goldman strategist Tim Moe to take an axe to his Korean market target.

items.title: My wife has only $80,000 saved for retirement. I have $2.2 million. Am I wrong to be shocked?
items.content: “When I brought up retiring last spring, she said she was ready whenever I was, and I took that to mean we were in good shape.”
